title: Invoice intake for a bookkeeping firm
whatItDoes: Watches a folder for supplier invoices, reads each PDF and adds one row per invoice to a spreadsheet, so nobody retypes them.
howToTry: Open the demo sheet, drop any PDF from the samples folder into the inbox folder and wait about a minute for its row to appear.
tested: Ran all 50 sample invoices twice. 49 were read fully and one scanned invoice was sent to the review list.
clientProvides: A mailbox or folder where invoices arrive, edit access to their spreadsheet, and ten real invoices to tune the reading.

checks.check: All 50 sample invoices are read into the sheet
checks.evidence: 49 of 50 rows are in the sheet; the scanned invoice went to the review list instead.

checks.check: A duplicate invoice is flagged and not entered twice
checks.evidence: All three duplicates are marked in the Duplicate column, shown in the demo at 1:20.

checks.check: An invoice that cannot be read is listed for a person to check
checks.evidence: The scanned invoice appears on the Review tab with its file name and the reason.

notIncluded: Nothing is posted to an accounting system, and handwritten invoices are not read.
followOn: Posting approved rows to the accounting system with an approval step, about two weeks of work.
